import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import sysconfig
import tempfile
import time

BASE = Path('/workspace/scratch/3ba735e28fa7')
ROOT = BASE / 'pystachy-audit-694'
OLD = BASE / 'pystachy-audit-742'
OUT = ROOT / 'build/audit-694'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PY = '/root/.local/bin/python3.13'
LLVM = str(BASE / 'llvm18-recovered/usr/lib/llvm-18/bin')
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('PYSTACHY_', 'COVERAGE_'))}
ENV.update(PYSTACHY_HOME=str(ROOT), PYSTACHY_LLVM=LLVM, PYSTACHY_JOBS='2', PY=PY, PATH=LLVM+':'+ENV['PATH'])
def save(n, v):
    (OUT/(n+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(v, indent=2)+'\n')
def run(n, args, extra=None, expected=0):
    start = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=ROOT, env=ENV | (extra or {}), text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=1800)
    r = dict(command=args, environment=extra or {}, returncode=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr=p.stderr, wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start, expected_exit=expected)
    save(n, r)
    print(n, p.returncode, p.stdout[-350:], p.stderr[-250:], flush=True)
    assert p.returncode == expected
    return r
files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for pattern in ['tests/lib_weakref*.py', 'tests/upstream_weakref.py', 'tests/errors/weakref_*.py'] for p in ROOT.glob(pattern))
save('selection', files)
mode = sys.argv[1]
if mode == 'checks':
    for label, compiler, extra in [('native', './pystachy', {}), ('gc', './pystachy', {'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM':'1'}), ('noopt', './pystachy', {'PYSTACHY_OPT':'-all'}), ('hosted', PY+' -m pystachy', {})]:
        run('checks-'+label, ['tests/run.sh', compiler, 'jit aot', *files], extra)
elif mode == 'references':
    results = {}
    for f in files:
        if '/errors/' in f:
            continue
        p = subprocess.run([PY, f, 'a1', 'a2'], cwd=ROOT, env=ENV, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
        err = (ROOT/f).with_suffix('.err')
        expected_err = err.read_text() if err.exists() else ''
        # Repository harness compares only the last stderr line (tracebacks vary).
        stderr_last = p.stderr.splitlines()[-1]+'\n' if p.stderr else ''
        ok = p.stdout+f'[exit {p.returncode}]\n' == (ROOT/f).with_suffix('.out').read_text() and stderr_last == expected_err
        results[f] = dict(exit=p.returncode, stdout=p.stdout, stderr_last=stderr_last, stderr_sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.stderr.encode()).hexdigest(), recording_equal=ok)
    save('references', results)
    assert all(r['recording_equal'] for r in results.values())
    print('references', len(results), flush=True)
elif mode == 'contracts':
    run('runtime', ['make', 'check-runtime', 'PY='+PY])
    run('ir', ['tools/check_ir.sh', './pystachy', 'pystachy.py', 'runtime.py', *[f for f in files if '/errors/' not in f]])
    run('weakrefprobe', ['make', 'weakrefprobe', 'PY='+PY])
    flags = ['-O2', '-fsanitize=undefined', '-fno-sanitize-recover=all']
    run('ubsan-probe-ir', [LLVM+'/clang', *flags, '-S', '-emit-llvm', 'tools/weakrefprobe.c', '-o', str(OUT/'probe.ll')])
    run('ubsan-probe-link', [LLVM+'/llvm-link', 'build/weakrefprobe-rt.ll', str(OUT/'probe.ll'), '-o', str(OUT/'probe.bc')])
    run('ubsan-probe-build', [LLVM+'/clang', *flags, str(OUT/'probe.bc'), '-o', str(OUT/'probe'), '-lm'])
    run('ubsan-probe', [str(OUT/'probe')])
    run('ubsan-probe-gc', [str(OUT/'probe')], {'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS':'1'})
elif mode == 'sweeps':
    for n, opts in [('imports', ['./pystachy']), ('stubs', ['--stubs'])]:
        run(n+'-command', [PY, 'tools/import_sweep.py', '-j', '2', '--metadata', str(OUT/(n+'-metadata.json')), *opts, sysconfig.get_path('stdlib'), str(OUT/(n+'.json'))])
elif mode == 'sanitized':
    flags = '-fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all'
    lib = subprocess.check_output([LLVM+'/clang', '-print-file-name=libclang_rt.ubsan_standalone-x86_64.so'], text=True).strip()
    assert Path(lib).exists()
    selected = [f for f in files if '/errors/' not in f]
    run('sanitized-aot', ['tests/run.sh', './pystachy', 'aot', *selected], {'PYSTACHY_CFLAGS':flags})
    run('sanitized-jit', ['tests/run.sh', './pystachy', 'jit', *selected], {'PYSTACHY_CFLAGS':flags, 'LD_PRELOAD':lib, 'UBSAN_OPTIONS':'handle_segv=0'})
elif mode == 'adjacent':
    selected = ['tests/gc_churn.py','tests/gc_dict_values.py','tests/gc_list_kinds.py','tests/gc_template_empty_kind.py','tests/sys_warnoptions.py','tests/exc_class_misc.py','tests/port_ordered_set_edges.py','tests/port_sortedcontainers_index.py']
    save('adjacent-selection', selected)
    run('adjacent-gc',['tests/run.sh','./pystachy','jit aot',*selected],{'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM':'1'})
    for name, args in [('richards',['1']),('raytrace',['1','20','20'])]:
        f='bench/pyperformance/'+name+'.py'
        ref=run(name+'-cpython',[PY,f,*args])['stdout']
        assert run(name+'-jit',['./pystachy','run',f,*args],{'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS_PROGRAM':'1'})['stdout']==ref
        exe=OUT/name
        run(name+'-build',['./pystachy','build',f,'-o',str(exe)])
        assert run(name+'-aot',[str(exe),*args],{'PYSTACHY_GC_STRESS':'1'})['stdout']==ref
elif mode == 'negative':
    original = (ROOT/'runtime.c').read_text()
    changes = {
        'orphan': ('    if (ref->fire && !gc_marked(ref->fire)) ref->fire = NULL;\n', ''),
        'queue-root': ('  if (wr_nfired > wr_head) scan((const W *)(wr_fired + wr_head), (const W *)(wr_fired + wr_nfired));   /* (NULL before the first) */\n', ''),
    }
    for name, (before, after) in changes.items():
        assert original.count(before)==1
        runtime = OUT/(name+'-runtime.c')
        runtime.write_text(original.replace(before, after))
        source = (ROOT/'tools/weakrefprobe.c').read_text().replace('#include "../runtime.c"', '#include "'+str(runtime)+'"')
        if name == 'orphan':
